# Slack developer docs | Slack Developer Docs

Source: https://docs.slack.dev/tools/bolt-js/docs

## Get started[](https://docs.slack.dev#get-started)

Create your first Slack app quickly.

### Install the Slack CLI

Download the command-line tool for developing Slack apps.

`curl -fsSL https://downloads.slack-edge.com/slack-cli/install.sh | bash`### Connect to your workspace

Log in and authenticate with your Slack workspace.

`slack login`### Create a project

Set up a new Bolt project from a starter template.

`slack create`### Run your app

See your app working in Slack.

`slack run`## Explore sample apps[](https://docs.slack.dev#explore-sample-apps)

Jumpstart your projects with ready-to-use examples.
